clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stormwind Stockade, Targorr the Dread awaits an execution stopped by nobles in Stormwind. Once Gath'Ilzogg's supreme executioner in the Redridge Mountains, the captured orc is now the subject of Guard Berton's demand for proof of his death in Lakeshire.

Targorr the Dread earned infamy across Redridge as the Blackrock clan warlord Gath'Ilzogg's brutal executioner. He tortured and slaughtered defenders of the Kingdom of Stormwind before his capture and death sentence in the Stormwind Stockade. Stormwind nobles intervened and mysteriously suspended the sentence. Guardsmen like Berton suspect foul play and corruption in the capital.

Guard Berton fears Targorr could become a political pawn or arrange an escape, so he hires an outside champion to enter the volatile prison and finish what the courts delayed. Taking Targorr's head bypasses the stalled legal system and gives closure to grieving families and Lakeshire's besieged defenders, who suffered under the executioner's blades.
